intro: Covers affirmative, negative, and question forms of Past Simple (regular and irregular verbs).

items.q: They ___ not watch TV last night.
items.why: Past Simple negative uses 'did not'; auxiliary is 'did'.
Past Simple yes/no question starts with auxiliary 'did'.

items.q: He ___ his bag at school yesterday.
We ___ a film at the cinema last week.
items.why: Regular Past Simple adds '-ed' to the base verb.

parts.title: Complete the sentences with the correct form.

items.why: Regular verb: add '-ed' for Past Simple affirmative.
Past Simple negative: 'did not' + base form.
Past Simple question with 'be': invert subject and 'was/were'.
Past Simple negative: 'did not' + base form, no '-ed' on main verb.
Past Simple Wh-question: Wh-word + 'did' + subject + base form.

parts.title: Find and correct the mistake in each sentence.

items.sentence: She didn't went to the gym yesterday.
items.corrected: She didn't go to the gym yesterday.
items.why: After 'did not', use base form, not Past Simple form.

items.sentence: Did he worked in a café last summer?
items.corrected: Did he work in a café last summer?
items.why: After auxiliary 'did' in questions, use base form only.

items.sentence: We was at home all day on Sunday.
items.corrected: We were at home all day on Sunday.
items.why: Past Simple of 'be' with plural subject 'we' is 'were'.

parts.title: Write your own sentences.
parts.pointsLabel: 2 points: 1 for correct form, 1 for meaning and use

items.prompt: Write one sentence about something you did last weekend.
items.criteria: Accept any grammatically correct Past Simple affirmative sentence with a correct regular or irregular verb form and a past time expression.
items.example: I visited my grandparents last weekend.

items.prompt: Write one sentence about something you did not do yesterday.
items.criteria: Accept any grammatically correct Past Simple negative sentence using 'did not / didn't' followed by a base form verb.
